fact: GUCE CI launched its GUCE Mobile app on 25 July 2024, covering five modules including e-DAU for customs declarations, on top of a portal that has handled customs formalities electronically for several years.
title: INNOVATION ET DEMATÉRIALISATION DANS L’ÉCOSYSTEME DU COMMERCE EXTÉRIEUR : GUCE CI LANCE SA NOUVELLE APPLICATION GUCE MOBILE
publisher: Guichet Unique du Commerce Extérieur - Côte d'Ivoire
